paragraphs: South Louisiana lawn & outdoor treatments

From our signature lawn program to aeration, ornamental care, and targeted pest services, Grow Green helps you choose what your property actually needs—with treatments timed for South Louisiana seasons.
You do not need to diagnose the property before calling. Choose the closest goal below, explore the services, or send us the address and let our local team help.
Control weeds, support seasonal color, monitor problems, and build a healthier warm-season lawn.
Address compaction, improve pathways into the root zone, and support stronger turf from below.
Reduce bed weeds and give valuable trees and shrubs seasonally timed attention.
Target fire ants, mosquitoes, fleas, ticks, and damaging lawn insects with the appropriate service.
Explore Grow Green services
Our signature lawn program is the starting point for many homeowners. Aeration, landscape, disease, insect, and outdoor pest services can be added when they match the property and your goals.
A year-round, year-round lawn program built around South Louisiana weather, weed pressure, warm-season turf, and what the lawn needs at each stage of the season.
Help identifying and targeting chinch bugs, armyworms, mole crickets, sod webworms, and other turf-feeding pests when symptoms fit insect activity.
Inspection, treatment, and practical recovery guidance for suspected large patch, dollar spot, gray leaf spot, and other lawn disease concerns.
Mechanical removal of small soil plugs to create pathways for air, water, and nutrients while relieving surface compaction.
A liquid soil-conditioning option designed to improve water movement and complement an overall lawn and soil program without pulling plugs.
A six-step ornamental program combining seasonally appropriate nutrition, inspection, and labeled insect and disease treatments.
Pre-emergent prevention, careful spot treatment, inspection, and realistic maintenance expectations for established landscape beds.
Planned treatment that targets fire ant pressure across the lawn, helping reduce active mounds and the chance of painful encounters.
Outdoor treatment focused on appropriate landscape and harborage areas, with recurring warm-season and one-time event options.
A plan that makes sense

Many customers begin with year-round fertilization and weed control, then layer in soil, landscape, or pest services based on their goals. Each service has a clear job—there is no reason to buy an add-on that does not fit.
Not sure which service?

faqs.q: Do I need to know exactly which service I need?
faqs.a: No. Choose “Not sure — recommend a service” in the quote form and describe what you see. We can help separate likely weed, insect, disease, irrigation, soil, or maintenance issues before recommending the next step.

faqs.q: Is Grow Green a mowing or landscaping company?
faqs.a: No. Grow Green is a specialized lawn and landscape treatment company. We focus on fertilization, weed control, lawn insects and disease, aeration, ornamental care, flower bed weed control, and specific outdoor pest programs.

faqs.q: What is the main lawn program?
faqs.a: Our signature service includes seasonal planned treatments per year, generally spaced about six weeks apart. The program combines seasonally appropriate nutrition, weed prevention, active weed control, and routine monitoring for South Louisiana warm-season lawns.

faqs.q: Can I request several services at the same time?
faqs.a: Yes. Select every service you are considering. We can price them separately, explain which ones fit the property, and let you decide what to approve.

faqs.q: Do I have to sign a long-term contract?
faqs.a: No. The lawn program uses month-to-month billing rather than a long-term service contract. Individual and add-on service terms are explained clearly in the estimate before you approve anything.

Pricing depends on the selected service, measured treatable area, property access, landscape conditions, and service scope. That is why we request the service address instead of giving every property the same generic price.

faqs.q: What should children and pets do around treatments?
faqs.a: Keep people and pets away during application and follow the re-entry instructions provided after service—often until treated surfaces are dry. Product-specific label directions always control, and pet flea or tick prevention should be coordinated with your veterinarian.

faqs.q: Where does Grow Green provide service?
faqs.a: We serve Baton Rouge and nearby communities across Ascension and Livingston, including St. Amant, Prairieville, Gonzales, Geismar, Dutchtown, Sorrento, Denham Springs, Walker, Central, Zachary, and surrounding areas. Send the address and we will confirm availability.

faqs.q: How quickly will I receive an estimate?
faqs.a: Most estimates are prepared within one business day, Monday through Friday. Complex properties or requests that require an on-site look may take a little longer, and our office will keep you informed.

    Common questions

    Choosing the right Grow Green service.

    You can select multiple services on one request. If you are unsure, describe the problem and our local team will help narrow it down.

    Do I need to know exactly which service I need?

    No. Choose “Not sure — recommend a service” in the quote form and describe what you see. We can help separate likely weed, insect, disease, irrigation, soil, or maintenance issues before recommending the next step.

    Is Grow Green a mowing or landscaping company?

    No. Grow Green is a specialized lawn and landscape treatment company. We focus on fertilization, weed control, lawn insects and disease, aeration, ornamental care, flower bed weed control, and specific outdoor pest programs.

    What is the main lawn program?

    Our signature service includes seasonal planned treatments per year, generally spaced about six weeks apart. The program combines seasonally appropriate nutrition, weed prevention, active weed control, and routine monitoring for South Louisiana warm-season lawns.

    Can I request several services at the same time?

    Yes. Select every service you are considering. We can price them separately, explain which ones fit the property, and let you decide what to approve.

    Do I have to sign a long-term contract?

    No. The lawn program uses month-to-month billing rather than a long-term service contract. Individual and add-on service terms are explained clearly in the estimate before you approve anything.

    How is my quote calculated?

    Pricing depends on the selected service, measured treatable area, property access, landscape conditions, and service scope. That is why we request the service address instead of giving every property the same generic price.

    What should children and pets do around treatments?

    Keep people and pets away during application and follow the re-entry instructions provided after service—often until treated surfaces are dry. Product-specific label directions always control, and pet flea or tick prevention should be coordinated with your veterinarian.

    Where does Grow Green provide service?

    We serve Baton Rouge and nearby communities across Ascension and Livingston, including St. Amant, Prairieville, Gonzales, Geismar, Dutchtown, Sorrento, Denham Springs, Walker, Central, Zachary, and surrounding areas. Send the address and we will confirm availability.

    How quickly will I receive an estimate?

    Most estimates are prepared within one business day, Monday through Friday. Complex properties or requests that require an on-site look may take a little longer, and our office will keep you informed.

    Let’s build the right plan for your property.

Pricing depends on the selected service, measured treatable area, property access, landscape conditions, and service scope. That is why we request the service address instead of giving every property the same generic price.

real_faqs.q: What should children and pets do around treatments?
real_faqs.a: Keep people and pets away during application and follow the re-entry instructions provided after service—often until treated surfaces are dry. Product-specific label directions always control, and pet flea or tick prevention should be coordinated with your veterinarian.

real_faqs.q: Where does Grow Green provide service?
real_faqs.a: We serve Baton Rouge and nearby communities across Ascension and Livingston, including St. Amant, Prairieville, Gonzales, Geismar, Dutchtown, Sorrento, Denham Springs, Walker, Central, Zachary, and surrounding areas. Send the address and we will confirm availability.

real_faqs.q: How quickly will I receive an estimate?
real_faqs.a: Most estimates are prepared within one business day, Monday through Friday. Complex properties or requests that require an on-site look may take a little longer, and our office will keep you informed.
